description: G-1 contracts-only task: adds 27 P6A event types to EVENT_TYPE_REGISTRY in @projexlight/contracts plus cross-SDK types (AgentContext, CompletionRequest/Response, StreamChunk, CapabilityToken, ExecutionLogEntry, ToolManifest, TraceSpan/Timeline, MCP types). No HTTP surface — the 'endpoint' is a synthetic in-process registry mutation. Enforcement is the existing assertRegisteredEventType() guard plus the producer-side schema validator (OC-2 doctrine). METHOD CORRECTED (was POST): the endpoint is an internal:// pseudo-URL with no HTTP route, and skipReason said so, but declaring method=POST meant the test runner built a real HTTP request and dispatched it — reporting a failure for something the definition itself declares untestable. INTERNAL_FUNCTION is the method the runner skips, which is what testability:manual was always meant to express.
skipReason: Contracts-only update. No HTTP route exists. Verification is the existing CI lint (assertRegisteredEventType) plus type-check; both run via `pnpm -w build`.

testCases.name: Manual: verify event registry contains all P6A keys + types compile
